summary: Grab Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing Q2 2026 results and a new $750 million share repurchase program. The buyback is part of ongoing capital returns to shareholders. Q2 revenue rose 22% year-over-year to $997 million, with adjusted EBITDA up 54% to $168 million. The company also reported a one-time $307 million gain from consolidating Superbank. The repurchase program execution timeline and mechanics were not detailed. Watch for continued buyback execution, potential impact on share count, and capital allocation priorities amidst growth investments.
